name: Basic RBAC
description: Role-based access control with three roles: admin, editor, and viewer. Organizations scope access. Documents inherit viewer access from organization members.

payload.model:
model
  schema 1.1

type user

type organization
  relations
    define admin: [user]
    define editor: [user] or admin
    define member: [user] or editor

type document
  relations
    define org: [organization]
    define owner: [user]
    define editor: [user] or owner or editor from org
    define viewer: [user] or editor or member from org
